name: zvideo_commit_fog_target_color_if_changed
description: zVideo::CommitFogTargetColorIfChanged copies pending target fog RGB255 values to the applied fog RGB255 globals and invokes the fog-color update callback only when any channel changed.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zVideo fog helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo/zRndr fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4a73a0 compares the applied RGB255 fog globals with the target RGB255 fog globals, returns when all three match, otherwise copies target RGB255 values to the applied RGB255 globals and dispatches through g_zVideo_pfnUpdateFogColor.

The native smoke verifies equal target/applied values do not invoke the callback, changed target values are copied to the applied fog color and invoke the callback once, and a repeated commit after the copy does not invoke the callback again.
